f.period >= #{beginPeriod} AND f.period <= #{endPeriod}
AND (m.code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR m.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))

mapper.sql: SELECT i.material_id, COALESCE(i.delivery_date, o.delivery_date, o.order_date) AS due_date, i.qty - i.done_qty + i.replenish_qty AS remaining, o.id AS order_id FROM scm_order_item i JOIN scm_order o ON o.id = i.order_id WHERE o.kind = 'SALES' AND o.status IN ('APPROVED', 'PARTIAL') AND i.qty - i.done_qty + i.replenish_qty > 0
mapper.select: SELECT f.material_id AS "materialId", f.period AS "period", f.qty - COALESCE(s.qty, 0) AS "qty" FROM mes_forecast f LEFT JOIN ( SELECT x.material_id, YEAR(x.due_date) * 100 + MONTH(x.due_date) AS period, SUM(x.remaining) AS qty FROM () x GROUP BY x.material_id, YEAR(x.due_date) * 100 + MONTH(x.due_date) ) s ON s.material_id = f.material_id AND s.period = f.period WHERE f.period >= #{beginPeriod} AND f.period <= #{endPeriod} AND f.qty - COALESCE(s.qty, 0) > 0

SELECT x.material_id AS "materialId", MIN(x.due_date) AS "dueDate", SUM(x.remaining) - COALESCE(MAX(p.qty), 0) AS "qty" FROM () x LEFT JOIN (SELECT sales_order_id, material_id, SUM(qty) AS qty FROM mes_plan WHERE sales_order_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY sales_order_id, material_id) p ON p.sales_order_id = x.order_id AND p.material_id = x.material_id GROUP BY x.order_id, x.material_id HAVING SUM(x.remaining) - COALESCE(MAX(p.qty), 0) > 0
